'''Aeradin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Professor/Legends|professor]] of system geography and assistant dean at the [[Leadership School]] on [[Andara/Legends|Andara]]. He hosted the [[General Information Contest]] in the [[Great Hall of Learning]].

Aeradin was a tall, thin being, with four antennae on his head.
